name: Nordstart
author: espen
description: Workspace launcher with pinned apps, an installed-app search, and session actions

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: Open the launcher when the pointer rests on the bar icon. Click and the keyboard shortcut still toggle it.

schema.label: Workspace preview
schema.description: Show a live preview of the selected workspace's window on the right. Turn this off if capture is slow or unsupported.

schema.label: Workspaces shown
schema.description: How many workspaces appear in the grid, empty or not. Hyprland workspaces above this are ignored.

schema.label: Pinned apps
schema.description: Comma-separated desktop entry ids. Running apps switch to their workspace; the rest open on the first empty workspace.

schema.label: App names
schema.description: Override display names. Use id=Name pairs (org.gnome.Nautilus=Files,firefox=Web) or a JSON object. User names win over the built-in map.

schema.label: App aliases
schema.description: Extra desktop-id aliases for pinning and running-state matching. Use id=alias|alias pairs (files=nautilus|org.gnome.Nautilus) or a JSON object.
